title: EtherCAT slave controller frame processing: on-the-fly datagram execution, 1 KB process RAM, two FMMUs, FCS regeneration

fields.desc: 1 = write MEM_WDATA at MEM_ADDR (dropped if a frame writes the same octet in that clock)

regs.name: FRAME
regs.desc: Frame report, one per forwarded frame; reading it frees it

fdesc.fr_wkc: this station's working counter increments, saturating at 255

features: Datagrams executed as the frame passes (5-clock latency): APRD / APWR / APRW, FPRD / FPWR / FPRW, BRD / BWR / BRW, LRD / LWR / LRW, ARMW / FRMW, NOP
Working counter and ADP increment, BRD / BRW OR of read data, any number of datagrams per frame
Two octet-granular FMMUs for logical addressing, 1 KB process RAM, station address register
FCS recomputed over the forwarded frame; a bad received FCS is passed on inverted
notes: rx_dv / rx_d carry the frame from the destination address to the FCS, one octet per PCLK; tx_dv / tx_d forward it. Frames need 5 idle clocks between them.
Not implemented: distributed clocks, SyncManagers, AL state machine, EEPROM / SII, mailbox, bit-granular FMMUs, VLAN tags, multiple ports.
sequence: Write the station address (0x0010..0x0011) and FMMUs (0x0600..) through MEM_ADDR / MEM_WDATA / CMD.host_wr, preload the process RAM the same way.
On IRQ FRAME_AVAIL read FRAME for each frame; read process data with CMD.host_rd and MEM_RDATA.
